description: Step 10 of docs/the-delivery-loop.md: the holdings of a delivered branch released, every gesture safe to run again. The mandate is one JSON object naming the repo and the branch, with base, forge_repo and issue optional; an unsaid base is the trunk the repository declares, and an unsaid issue means the work closed none: the closing comment is neither written nor judged nor sent, and everything else the branch holds is still released. The proof is the merged pull request of the branch, read from the host so a rerun after the branch is gone still finds it, and the remote trunk must carry both its head and its merge commit before anything is deleted. The closing comment names that commit and passes the publication gate before it leaves; an issue already closed is left as it is. The worktree holding the branch is removed only when it is clean and nobody holds its lock; the local and remote branches are deleted only when the remote trunk carries their tip, and the remote deletion follows the push policy read from the trusted trunk. Before the remote branch comes down, archive_tag pushes refs/tags/archive/<branch> at the head the merged pull request proved, so a squashed head stays reachable once its branch is gone; a tag already there at another commit stops the run instead of being moved. The run is complete only when the issue, where one was named, reads closed, the remote carries the archive tag, and no worktree, local branch or remote branch is left. Every forge call runs as the account in sailor.forgeAs. What this flow defends against: a delivery policy that is missing, is not readable as JSON, or whose merge, push and release fields are not auto or ask, and a remote that cannot be read or has moved. It runs no sailor of its own, so it vouches for none. What it does not defend against: whoever closes a handed step, such as authorize_push, does it with the sailor on their own PATH.

with.command:
set -eu
common=$(cd "$REPO" && cd "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)" && pwd)
outgoing="$common/sailor/outgoing"
mkdir -p "$outgoing"
file="$outgoing/closing-issue-$ISSUE.md"
printf 'Closed by %s (pull request #%s), which the remote %s carries.\n' "$COMMIT" "$NUMBER" "$BASE" > "$file"
printf '{"text_file":"%s"}' "$file"

set -eu
tip=$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$BRANCH^{commit}" || true)
if [ -n "$tip" ]; then
    [ "$tip" = "$HEAD_PROVED" ] || git -C "$REPO" merge-base --is-ancestor "$tip" "$TRUNK_COMMIT" || { echo "the local $BRANCH at $tip carries commits the remote $BASE does not" >&2; exit 1; }
    git -C "$REPO" branch -D "$BRANCH" >&2
fi
printf '{"deleted":"%s"}' "$tip"

$join: The delivery policy read from the trusted trunk (commit
) asks a person before this flow may delete the remote branch. Approve with an output file holding {"authorized": true}, or reject with the reason.

options.label: authorize
options.facts: every check before this step passed on the recorded commit

options.label: refuse
options.facts: nothing outward has happened yet; the run stops here
